tools.name: list_ecosystems
tools.description: List the platforms Lode covers, with their sync-object vocabulary and how many integrations are recorded.

tools.name: find_integrations
tools.description: Find apps that integrate with an ecosystem, filtered and ranked for a buyer profile per Lode ranking policy (fit, not size or features). Returns score, match reasons and ties. Only published (verified) records are ranked; records still under review can be fetched by id with get_integration.

tools.name: get_integration
tools.description: Get the full verified record for one app + ecosystem pair: what syncs, pricing by currency, regions, requirements, limitations, connection safety, sources.

tools.name: compare_integrations
tools.description: Side-by-side facts for 2-4 integrations: sync coverage, cheapest price per currency, regions, setup time and limitations.

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: One company across every ecosystem Lode covers: its stable vendor id, domains, and its integration on each platform (for example Stripe on Xero and on Vercel). Look up by vendor id, domain, or name.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: What changed in Lode records, newest first: prices, sync capabilities, limits, regions and verification status. Each event has the old and new value, when Lode observed it, the sources behind it and a cause (new-coverage, lode-update, or source-change-likely when the cited page also changed).
